title: Find the exchange: four addresses the suspect paid, and where their USDT went (Tron, day 5 game)
as_of: Snapshot read from java-tron 4.8.2.4 on 11 Nov 2026: the four addresses' transfers 25 Sep-17 Oct 2023, and the Binance hot wallet's incoming USDT from 04:36 to 05:36 UTC on 10 Oct 2023. Labels from Binance's own published wallet list, updated 9 Oct 2023. The suspect is made up for the game; the addresses and transfers are real. Times are UTC.
